features.fullDescription: Ruin. Circa 1560-70. 3-storey and attic 36' x 28' with 23' dia. circular angle tower. Rubble-built, ground floor vaulted: original door in main building, transferred to angle tower slightly later. Remains of semi-circular arched gate, voussoirs fell 1920. Castle repaired 1736, unroofed by 1769, back wall fell in 1936.
